description: Found while building fz-sc8.72. In Elixir __MODULE__ in a function body is the enclosing module's atom (Elixir.Foo.Bar), and nil at the top level. In fz it fails to compile: "compiler2 lowering found unresolved value `__MODULE__`". The namespace already binds __ENV__ as a Splice symbol just before a body is expanded (src/compiler2/namespace.rs); __MODULE__ is the same mechanism with the module's atom as the spliced value, or a direct lowering through World::module_alias_atom. Fix in one place, with an oracle fixture on interp, run and build. Deviation from Elixir; not needed by the distiller.
title: __MODULE__ in a function body is the module's atom
